STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_08715_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_08715_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_08715(
    input clk,
    input [3:0] dig10, dig11,
    input [3:0] dig20, dig21,
    input [9:0] x, y,
    output [3:0] text_on,
    output reg [11:0] text_rgb
    );

    wire [10:0] rom_addr;
    reg [6:0] char_addr, char_addr_s, char_addr_l, char_addr_r, char_addr_o;
    reg [3:0] row_addr;
    wire [3:0] row_addr_s, row_addr_l, row_addr_r, row_addr_o;
    reg [2:0] bit_addr;
    wire [2:0] bit_addr_s, bit_addr_l, bit_addr_r, bit_addr_o;
    wire [7:0] ascii_word;
    wire ascii_bit, score_on, logo_on, rule_on, over_on;

    // Embedded ROM for ASCII characters
    reg [7:0] rom [0:2047];

    initial begin
        // Initialize ASCII ROM with some values
        $readmemh("ascii_rom_data.mem", rom);
    end

    assign ascii_word = rom[rom_addr];

    assign score_on = (y >= 32) && (y < 64) && (x[9:4] < 32);
    assign row_addr_s = y[4:1];
    assign bit_addr_s = x[3:1];
    always @* begin
    case(x[8:4])
        5'h0 : char_addr_s = 7'h00; 
        5'h1 : char_addr_s = 7'h50;     
        5'h2 : char_addr_s = 7'h4C;     
        5'h3 : char_addr_s = 7'h41;     
        5'h4 : char_addr_s = 7'h59;     
        5'h5 : char_addr_s = 7'h45;     
        5'h6 : char_addr_s = 7'h52;     
        5'h7 : char_addr_s = 7'h20;     
        5'h8 : char_addr_s = 7'h31;     
        5'h9 : char_addr_s = 7'h3A;     
        5'hA : char_addr_s = {3'b011, dig11};    
        5'hB : char_addr_s = {3'b011, dig10};    
        5'hC : char_addr_s = 7'h00;     
        5'hD : char_addr_s = 7'h00;     
        5'hE : char_addr_s = 7'h50;     
        5'hF : char_addr_s = 7'h4C;     
        5'h10 : char_addr_s = 7'h41;     
        5'h11 : char_addr_s = 7'h59;     
        5'h12 : char_addr_s = 7'h45;     
        5'h13 : char_addr_s = 7'h52;     
        5'h14 : char_addr_s = 7'h20;     
        5'h15 : char_addr_s = 7'h32;     
        5'h16 : char_addr_s = 7'h3A;     
        5'h17 : char_addr_s = {3'b011, dig21};    
        5'h18 : char_addr_s = {3'b011, dig20};    
        5'h19 : char_addr_s = 7'h00;     
        5'h1A : char_addr_s = 7'h00;     
        5'h1B : char_addr_s = 7'h00;     
        5'h1C : char_addr_s = 7'h00;     
        5'h1D : char_addr_s = 7'h00;     
        5'h1E : char_addr_s = 7'h00;     
        5'h1F : char_addr_s = 7'h00;
    endcase
    end

    assign over_on = (y[9:6] == 3) && (5 <= x[9:5]) && (x[9:5] <= 13);
    assign row_addr_o = y[5:2];
    assign bit_addr_o = x[4:2];
    always @* begin
        case(x[8:5])
            4'h5 : char_addr_o = 7'h47;     
            4'h6 : char_addr_o = 7'h41;     
            4'h7 : char_addr_o = 7'h4D;     
            4'h8 : char_addr_o = 7'h45;     
            4'h9 : char_addr_o = 7'h00;     
            4'hA : char_addr_o = 7'h4F;     
            4'hB : char_addr_o = 7'h56;     
            4'hC : char_addr_o = 7'h45;     
            default : char_addr_o = 7'h52;  
        endcase
    end

    always @* begin
        text_rgb = 12'h0FF;
        if(score_on) begin
            char_addr = char_addr_s;
            row_addr = row_addr_s;
            bit_addr = bit_addr_s;
            if(ascii_bit)
                text_rgb = 12'hF00; 
        end else begin 
            char_addr = char_addr_o;
            row_addr = row_addr_o;
            bit_addr = bit_addr_o;
            if(ascii_bit)
                text_rgb = 12'hF00; 
        end        
    end

    assign text_on = {score_on, logo_on, rule_on, over_on};
    assign rom_addr = {char_addr, row_addr};
    assign ascii_bit = ascii_word[~bit_addr];
      
endmodule
STAGE 2

Generate the module

InputThe generated Stage 1 specification plus the required top-module name rtlpp_08715.
InstructionImplement the complete synthesizable RTL module from the generated specification.

Protocol summary; the Stage 2 runner creates a fresh prompt.

OutputReconstructed complete RTL module.
Stage 1 output → abstraction gate → fresh Stage 2 input. The intermediate text is generated separately for each model/attempt. It is not a prefilled golden description. Stage 2 receives neither the clean RTL nor the Stage 1 conversation.

Private final evaluation

Reference RTLClean RTL in the imported source record; hidden from Stage 2.
Score / oracleBinary formal equivalence to the hidden clean module

The formal oracle consumes the complete Stage 2 RTL file and compares it with the clean reference. A golden RTL file is scoring material, not a generated Stage 1 output.
